name: 06801 · Bethel, CT
findings: ZIP 06801 (Bethel) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06801 (Bethel) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06801 (Bethel) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
